machinery_vs_regulator_split_rationale: PRIMARY biogenesis score = MACHINERY ONLY (import TOM/TIM, MICOS, OXPHOS assembly+core structural subunits, mtDNA replication/transcription apparatus). Master transcriptional REGULATORS (PPARGC1A/PGC1a, PPARGC1B, NRF1, TFAM, ESRRA, GABPA, NFE2L2) are held OUT of the primary score and reported SEPARATELY. Rationale: PGC1a induction is the textbook DEFINITION of the exercise biogenesis response; scoring exercise with PGC1a inside the module is near-tautological and inflates the control. Machinery is the genuine independent test; regulators are reported alongside as the expected coactivator signal. Mirrors the project's 'machinery conserves, regulators diverge' principle.
selective_vs_shared_rationale: Selective mitophagy sub-score (shared_with_bulk_autophagy=False): PINK1, PRKN, BNIP3L/NIX, BNIP3, FUNDC1, FIS1 - genuine mito-selective receptors/machinery. OPTN and CALCOCO2/NDP52 are flagged shared=True: they are GENERAL autophagy receptors (xenophagy/aggrephagy), NOT mito-selective; including them in the selective arm reintroduces the bulk-autophagy confound. Core ATG machinery (ULK1/ATG13/ATG101/RB1CC1/BECN1/ATG5/ATG7/ATG12/MAP1LC3B/WIPI2/SQSTM1) and AMBRA1 also shared=True.
